items.title: World Bank's Banga: Availability of capital 'not really an issue' as AI demand drives up borrowing costs
items.body: World Bank President Ajay Banga came on CNBC's "Squawk Box" on Oct. 27, 2026.

items.title: Fed rate hikes are coming, but not this week: CNBC survey
items.body: The CNBC Fed Survey shows that 93% of respondent expect a pause at the Federal Reserve meeting taking place this week.

items.title: Analysis: Why a $2 trillion deficit and 5% Treasury yields are becoming America's biggest economic challenge
items.body: Treasury yields above 5% are raising borrowing costs for households and the federal government, highlighting the challenge of financing $2 trillion deficits.

items.title: Trump's approval rating on economy hits all-time low as midterm looms: CNBC survey
items.body: Eight out of 10 Americans now rate the economy as fair or poor, one of several findings in a CNBC poll that show why Republican candidates face uphill battles.

items.title: Jobless claims near the lowest since the 1960s as low-fire trend continues
items.body: Initial filings for unemployment insurance slipped to a seasonally adjusted 194,000.

items.title: Housing is flashing warning signs just as the Fed weighs more interest rate hikes
items.body: Housing data deteriorated further in September, according to separate reports Tuesday.

items.title: UK inflation jumps to 3.5% — cementing rate hike expectations
items.body: U.K. inflation rose by a hotter-than-expected 3.5% in the 12 months to September, driven by the surging cost of motor fuels.

items.title: Car buyers are demanding lower prices and better tech. Automakers must deliver both
items.body: Bain says tech leads purchase considerations in China while price remains No. 1 in the U.S. and Europe, as pressure mounts on Western carmakers.
